# Animated app UI mockups for launch videos — chats, terminals and code

**A script of messages, commands or code becomes an animated chat, terminal, notification or editor scene rebuilt in HTML.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_ecb6f84bf919.webp" alt="HTML-built UI mockups play in turn: a coding-agent terminal run, a team chat channel, a floating 3D code slab and a tilted analytics dashboard." width="480"></p>

Ten animated UI mockups for product, launch and dev-tool videos, rebuilt as HTML instead of screen recordings: phone message thread, team chat channel, coding-agent terminal session, terminal command run, desktop terminal window, desktop notification banner, code editor walkthrough, 3D code slab, exploded UI panels and an amber CRT console. Presets give typing speed (12-20 characters per second with seeded gaps), reading holds from character count, entrance easing and scale, camera lead before each action, text size as a share of frame height, and theme colors from MIT theme sources, from Charm VHS, Screen Studio, Emil Kowalski, Apple HIG and Netflix timing rules. Use when someone wants a fake text or Slack conversation, a terminal or Claude Code demo, a code walkthrough or an exploded UI shot in a video. NOT for recording a real screen or for real people's messages presented as genuine.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill app-ui-mockups                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills app-ui-mockups --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 73 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Animate the conversation in ./chat.json as a phone message thread for a 9:16 hook"
- "Show a coding-agent terminal session fixing a bug for my launch video, 20 seconds"
- "Make an exploded UI shot of my app screen with its layers floating apart, then sliding home"
